description: Prefix-cache hits for repeated prompts on glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp2. Each prompt was sent three times with identical text; rows are [prompt_tokens, cached_tokens, seconds]. The first send of each prompt is cold.
script: Chat completions with max_tokens 4, temperature 0 and the profile's thinking-off settings; prompts are random words from a 12-word list with a unique tag at the start.

4864.note: Profile with --block-size 256 and no split pages; vLLM raises the attention block to 4,864 tokens to match the linear-attention state size.
